sourceArticle.title: Why Yann LeCun is Spending $1 Billion to Replace LLMs with JEPA
sourceArticle.author: Julian Horsey

athenaOutput.directive: Decouple orchestration from autoregressive text generation by architecting an Objective-Driven Routing Matrix, preparing the Creative Liberation Engine to seamlessly ingest JEPA 'world models' for spatial reasoning and planning while retaining LLMs strictly for linguistic translation.
athenaOutput.rationale: Yann LeCun's $1B pivot to JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) entirely validates our Article XXIII: LLMs are components, not architecture. Autoregressive models hit a reasoning ceiling because they predict tokens, not physical or abstract reality. By anticipating the shift toward Objective-Driven AI, we can position the Creative Liberation Engine to orchestrate hybrid intelligence—using JEPA-style models to construct reliable, hallucination-free execution DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs) and spatial plans, while utilizing LLMs merely as the communication interface. This future-proofs artist sovereignty against the foundational limits of current Big AI.

options.title: Pluggable Intelligence Abstraction (The Article XXIII Approach)
options.description: Create a universal 'Intelligence Socket' in the routing contract. LLMs plug in for 'Scribe/Relay' linguistic tasks, while JEPA checkpoints plug in for 'Director/Cosmos' planning and spatial tasks. The system treats them as distinct sub-processors.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant upfront architectural refactoring to standardize outputs from fundamentally different model architectures (token streams vs. abstract embeddings).

options.title: Direct Open-Source Ingestion Framework (Article XXV Compliance)
options.description: Immediately build API adapters and custom integration wrappers for Meta's existing open-weight I-JEPA and V-JEPA models. Focus purely on integration and mounting rather than attempting to train our own predictive architecture.
options.tradeoffs: Current open-source JEPA models are highly experimental and research-grade, potentially lacking the production stability required for immediate zero-wait-time execution.

options.title: Visual/Spatial First Deployment for Creative Liberation
options.description: Isolate JEPA integration strictly to the CREATIVE DIRECTOR stance. Use predictive world models exclusively for 3D asset generation, VFX physics prediction, and spatial consistency, where autoregressive models fail hardest.
options.tradeoffs: Creates a siloed intelligence system and leaves the core engine orchestration (task planning) dependent on flawed LLM reasoning.

options.title: Objective-Driven Dispatch Redesign
options.description: Rewrite the Creative Liberation Engine's task-queue and dispatch systems to operate on energy-based models and objective-driven constraints. Tasks are evaluated by predicting the end-state embedding rather than generating a step-by-step text plan.
options.tradeoffs: Massive overhaul of the current Antigravity IDE and Creative Liberation Engine memory spine; risks breaking current stable V6 operational flow.

options.title: Simulated World-Model Pipeline (The Bridge Strategy)
options.description: Before production-ready JEPA models are fully integrated, simulate their architecture using current tools by enforcing a strict 'Predict-Verify-Act' loop in the memory spine, forcing LLMs to output abstract state predictions before writing execution code.
options.tradeoffs: Computationally expensive, increases latency, and is still ultimately bound by the underlying LLM's lack of true physical understanding.

options.title: Custom Sovereign JEPA Training
options.description: Utilize local NAS infrastructure to train a proprietary, artist-focused JEPA model from scratch, specifically tuned on design, code, and creative execution workflows.
options.tradeoffs: Directly violates Article XXV (Integration Over Reverse-Engineering). We do not have the $1B compute budget to beat Meta at foundation models. We must integrate, not replicate.
